params.name: acr-values
params.description: Specifies the Authentication Context Class Reference values that theAuthorization Server is being requested to use for the Auth Request.

params.name: audiences
params.description: A list of audiences that the OpenID Issuer may include that are accepted in addition to 'client-id'.

params.name: autocreate
params.description: Automatically create users if they do not exist.

params.name: base_dn
params.description: LDAP base domain name

params.name: bind_dn
params.description: LDAP bind domain name

params.name: capath
params.description: Path to the CA certificate store

params.name: case-sensitive
params.description: username is case-sensitive

params.name: cert
params.description: Path to the client certificate

params.name: certkey
params.description: Path to the client certificate key

params.name: check-connection
params.description: Check bind connection to the server.

params.name: client-id
params.description: OpenID Client ID

params.name: client-key
params.description: OpenID Client Key

params.name: comment
params.description: Description.

params.name: default
params.description: Use this as default realm

params.name: delete
params.description: A list of settings you want to delete.

params.name: digest
params.description: Prevent changes if current configuration file has a different digest. This can be used to prevent concurrent modifications.

params.name: domain
params.description: AD domain name

params.name: filter
params.description: LDAP filter for user sync.

params.name: group_classes
params.description: The objectclasses for groups.

params.name: group_dn
params.description: LDAP base domain name for group sync. If not set, the base_dn will be used.

params.name: group_filter
params.description: LDAP filter for group sync.

params.name: group_name_attr
params.description: LDAP attribute representing a groups name. If not set or found, the first value of the DN will be used as name.

params.name: groups-autocreate
params.description: Automatically create groups if they do not exist.

params.name: groups-claim
params.description: OpenID claim used to retrieve groups with.

params.name: groups-overwrite
params.description: All groups will be overwritten for the user on login.

params.name: issuer-url
params.description: OpenID Issuer Url

params.name: mode
params.description: LDAP protocol mode.

params.name: password
params.description: LDAP bind password. Will be stored in '/etc/pve/priv/realm/<REALM>.pw'.

params.name: port
params.description: Server port.

params.name: prompt
params.description: Specifies whether the Authorization Server prompts the End-User for reauthentication and consent.

params.name: query-userinfo
params.description: Enables querying the userinfo endpoint for claims values.

params.name: scopes
params.description: Specifies the scopes (user details) that should be authorized and returned, for example 'email' or 'profile'.

params.name: secure
params.description: Use secure LDAPS protocol. DEPRECATED: use 'mode' instead.

params.name: server1
params.description: Server IP address (or DNS name)

params.name: server2
params.description: Fallback Server IP address (or DNS name)

params.name: sslversion
params.description: LDAPS TLS/SSL version. It's not recommended to use version older than 1.2!

params.name: sync-defaults-options
params.description: The default options for behavior of synchronizations.

params.name: sync_attributes
params.description: Comma separated list of key=value pairs for specifying which LDAP attributes map to which PVE user field. For example, to map the LDAP attribute 'mail' to PVEs 'email', write  'email=mail'. By default, each PVE user field is represented  by an LDAP attribute of the same name.

params.name: tfa
params.description: Use Two-factor authentication.

params.name: user_attr
params.description: LDAP user attribute name

params.name: user_classes
params.description: The objectclasses for users.

params.name: verify
params.description: Verify the server's SSL certificate
